Results.ReviewText: The Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill is a great little grill with big grill capability. It is very portable, very easy to use, and very easy to keep clean. The cooking surface rivals that of a larger full-sized grill. With an accessory 6' propane tank gas line available for purchase, you can hook up a full sized propane tank for cooking, or a smaller camp stove sized propane tank for portability.

Results.ReviewText: Why would Weber build a grill that hast a temp control but but can’t go below 380 -400 degrees?  My black box 59.00 Weber propane grill has a wider temp range yet costs a quarter of the price.
Results.Title: Keep looking

Results.Title: Replacement parts

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill three months ago for my high school son. They take it to the high school parking lot for hot dog and s'more making. But, a couple of months ago, I decided to grill on it. I have not cooked in my oven in over a month (okay, it's too hot here). I use this grill in some capacity every night. I even bought a 10" baking stone and have been making pizzas on it. 

This grill is now my very favorite!  With only two of us in the house, it is the perfect size. I know it would work for a family of four perfectly, too. Hmmmm, some of the meals I have cooked include: stuffed peppers, poppers, salmon (weekly), steak, pork loin, more salmon, more steak, burgers, chicken, shrimp, sautéed onions along side steaks in a cast iron pan. I mean, really, the options are endless. It is small and might!!!

I love it so much, I bought one for my parents' RV. They love it, too! I am going to get one for my sister for her birthday. My entire family have pellet grills. My sister has a HUGE gas grill. I think this Weber Q1200 is perfect for a small family to use weekly. Less gas used and more meals prepared easily.
Results.Title: Small but Mighty

Results.ReviewText: After our kids have used their Weber for years, we decided to get the 1200 for camping. With the collapsible stand it is a slick addition to our outside cooking.
Results.Title: Industry standard

Results.ReviewText: I could use this grill everyday! It heats up quickly, very compact, good temperature control and best of all I get great grill marks. Downside: not able to fit proteins and vegies on grill surface together.

Results.ReviewText: I replaced a cheapo gas grill with this one.  What a difference!  I'm finding how easy it is to have everything come out perfect.  I knocked a star off because of how difficult it is to screw the propane tanks on.  Maybe they are not all this way, but the regulator is in so tight I have to pull it out away from the Weber at the same time I'm trying to thread the tank on.  Poor engineering, especially since I'm pulling on a gas line.
Results.Title: Worth the $. Better design needed for the propane
